decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already shows a quantified customer benefit of over 600,000 euros in annual savings, so its value is starting to materialize and it fits the firm's modular strategy, which justifies keeping the option open and investing further.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer, has its own dedicated page and costs little to keep, so dropping it while its prospects are positive would make no sense.

This second modular plant concept is only mentioned and has no results yet, so its uncertainty remains high, but keeping it is cheap and it shares development with Product A, so the option is worth holding a little longer.
The trommel screen is a low-cost extension of an established product line in a growing market, and nothing so far signals that its value is unlikely to be realized.
